CVE-2026-133250.title: @fastify/middie vulnerable to path-scoped middleware bypass via request path matching mismatches
CVE-2026-133250.description: @fastify/middie is the middleware engine for the Fastify web framework. In versions up to and including 9.3.7, middie matches path-scoped middleware against its own reading of the request path, which can differ from the path Fastify's router uses to dispatch the request. When the two disagree, the router can route a request to a handler covered by a middleware mount while middie skips that middleware, so an unauthenticated client reaches a handler that an authentication, authorization, or rate-limiting middleware was meant to protect, with no special configuration required. The mismatch is triggered by empty parameter or wildcard values, request targets that do not begin with a slash, and literal percent characters in a mount path. The issue is fixed in @fastify/middie 9.3.8, and users should upgrade to 9.3.8 or later.

CVE-2026-57565.title: Readest: Cross-tenant object write via unsanitized fileName in /api/storage/upload (object-key path traversal)

CVE-2026-84693.description: The WPvivid — Backup, Migration & Staging plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Deletion in version up to, and including, 0.9.134. CVE-2026-99642.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

mm/gup: check folio->mapping under folio lock in memfd_pin_folios()

memfd_pin_folios() pins folios from the page cache without taking the
folio lock. khugepaged or MADV_COLLAPSE can therefore replace a folio
after checking its refcount while memfd_pin_folios() still pins the old
folio. The caller then receives a folio which is no longer part of the
memfd.

For udmabuf and iommufd, this can cause data corruption: DMA accesses
the detached folio rather than the live memfd contents. DMA reads can
return stale data, while DMA writes update the detached copy and are
lost from the live memfd. The detached folio remains pinned, so these
accesses do not constitute a use-after-free or target another
application's memory. For memfd live update, the stale contents can
reappear in the memfd after handover.

page cache users do. If the folio was removed,…
